title: EASY MOBILITY
subtitle: SATURDAY SOFT. MOVE KINDLY. KEEP IT LIGHT.

script.welcome: Hello Pam. I'm Stratton. Saturday is easy mobility — a soft little break from the desk. About ten minutes. If a joint is sore, take a smaller range. Showing up is the win.
script.start: Whenever you're ready. Easy breath. This is meant to feel doable.
script.nextExercise: Next one. Shake it out if you like. No rush.
script.rest: Have a little rest. Breathe easy.
script.lastSet: Last set. Make it comfortable and clean.
script.complete: That's us. Lovely work. Soft mobility, and you showed up. Enjoy your Saturday — see you tomorrow.
script.resume: Back with you. Easy as we go.

exercises.name: SEATED KNEE LIFTS
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat. Soft belly. Lift one knee a little, then lower with control. Alternate sides like a gentle march. Keep the range small and kind. Hold the chair lightly if you like. Smaller lift is fine on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated knee lifts. Two sets of six each leg. Sit tall, soft belly, lift one knee a little, then lower. Keep it small and kind.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty five seconds. Easy breath. Soften the hips.

exercises.name: SEATED OVERHEAD REACH
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair. Soft belly. Empty hands or the lightest weights. Start with hands at about shoulder height and reach gently upward only as high as feels kind, then lower with control. Soft on the shoulders and neck. This is mobility, not a push. Smaller range is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated overhead reach. Two sets of six. Sit tall, soft belly, reach gently upward only as high as feels kind, then lower. Empty hands are fine.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty five seconds. Soften the shoulders.

exercises.name: CHAIR BALANCE
exercises.cue: Stand beside a sturdy chair and hold the back lightly. Soft belly, easy knees. Shift weight onto one foot and lift the other heel just a little — or keep both feet down and simply stand tall if that feels wiser today. Hold about twenty seconds, then switch sides. Use the chair as much as you need. Smaller lift is fine on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Chair balance. Two holds of about twenty seconds. Hold the chair lightly, soft belly, easy knees. Lift one heel a little, or keep both feet down if that feels wiser.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Soften the ankles. Easy breath.

exercises.name: SEATED FORWARD REACH
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat. Soft belly. Hinge gently from the hips and reach the hands forward toward the floor or your shins — only as far as feels kind. Soft neck, easy breath. Hold about twenty seconds, then stack tall again. Smaller reach is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated forward reach. Two holds of about twenty seconds. Soft belly, hinge gently from the hips, reach only as far as feels kind. Soft neck.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Soften the back. Easy breath.
exercises.speakDone: Forward reach done. That's the session — lovely work.
